notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-container-ccsid, program CACCSID (Apache-2.0 corpus, #7589): CHAR containers put and read back across CCSIDs 37, 500, 1140 and 1208, including the hex-literal 1208 container TWO. 1208 is real UTF-8 (IBM 'Conversion CCSIDs for CICS TS', Table 38): the program's bytes are read as raw UTF-8 or as the region's characters, whichever is valid, and both-valid is refused (register X17). The oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: convert
scenarios.why: PUT / GET CONTAINER with FROMCCSID and INTOCCSID over 37, 500, 1140 and 1208, ending with the UTF-8 container TWO read back in each page
